title: Creative Authoring Freedom & Evidence-Grounded Scene Compilation
hypotheses: A versioned generic V2-SceneGraph-backed input can compile at least three materially distinct attention storyboards, without hardcoded scene topology in renderer.
Knowledge-backed graph labels are derived from a host-verified ledger; model-authored layout, graphics, relationships and motions are not reduced to static cards or fixed A1..A4 choreography.
Fail-closed semantics target genuine false statements and broken references, not exact narration vocabulary or fixed 4-beat pacing.
All three decoded native H264/AAC artifacts have nonstatic transitions, perceptible image distinction and beat-aligned audio, but not necessarily demonstrated learner outcomes.
scope: OFFLINE_ONLY. No new provider POST or GET. No new model-authoring claim. V3-50 live one-shot consumed and must not be replayed.

source.name: Attention Is All You Need
source.claim_evidence: host arithmetic for illustrative 2-token attention Q,K,V, not empirical model weights

frozen_offline_variants.expected_visual: two key tokens, arrows, normalized weights

quality_gates.styles: bounded design tokens, not prescriptive composition
key_negative_controls: new unsupported math in free label
quality_gates.physical_media: 3 real native 1280x720 H264/AAC from HOST SYNTHETIC distinct SceneGraphs, source SHA and decoded frames; host-derived computed math
quality_gates.strict_sandbox: Docker --network none, readonly source and no model code

independent_comparison: compute SHA frame differences across frozen distinct variants at normalized times; absence of identical frames does not establish teaching advantage.
activation_policy: never include V3-50 activation marker in new commit messages; no inference credentials in workflow.
